newsitem.title: USA: Horizon Cellular increases tender offer price.
newsitem.headline: Horizon Cellular increases tender offer price.

text.p: Horizon Cellular Telephone Co said it had increased the purchase price in the tender offer for its 11-3/8 percent Senior Subordinated Discount Notes to $952.37 plus a consent fee of $20.00 for each $1,000 principal amount of notes.
As a result, holders who consent to the proposed amendments and tender their Notes by October 15 will receive aggregate cash payments of $972.37 for each $1,000 principal amount of Notes, it said.
Horizon said it expected to make payments by October 21.
